The lake itself is vast and the local communities thrive beneath Gitch Lake. Biowile in nature, Gitch Lake has created abundant spaces for nature to make us sit back and make sense of what nature calls. Biowile brings a healthy sense of self-governance to its communities that invites us to watch over its unforeseen corners.
